<reasoning>

<timeline>
- Federer double fault
- Nadal forehand winner on next point
</timeline>
<reflection>
The forehand winner happened after the double fault, so it is last.
</reflection>
</reasoning>
<answer>Nadal hit a forehand winner</answer>
